# Galahad — Instruction Blindness in Vision-Language-Action Policies

> A vision-language-action (VLA) policy can pass a manipulation benchmark without reading its
> instruction. We name that failure mode "instruction blindness", show it is a measurable instance of
> causal confusion in imitation learning, locate its mechanism, and cure it with a data recipe rather
> than an architecture. Galahad is the released policy that validates the cure.

## Paper

- Title: Instruction Blindness in Vision-Language-Action Policies: Diagnosis and a Low-Rank Data Cure
- Authors: Yuchen Liu, Muchen Han (Φ(fight) Research; HKUST)
- PDF: https://xn--7xa.monster/Galahad/static/galahad.pdf
- Project page: https://xn--7xa.monster/Galahad/
- Status: preprint, under review

## The finding

Standard manipulation benchmarks place the named object where the policy expects it, so a position
shortcut and genuine language grounding earn the same score. On the one axis that separates them —
object identity, rename the target and keep the scene — published evaluations put the field at 0-1%
correct object selection. Four open world-action models we ran reach 20-45%.

## The mechanism

The pretrained backbone resolves the named object in its language stream; the action head routes
position and never reads that binding. No training-time regularizer on the confounded data reopens
the route. Because the knowledge is present and only the routing is missing, the repair is a data
recipe.

## The cure

Make the instruction the only predictor of the target (every object appears as target and as
distractor across randomized positions), and protect the pretrained resolution with a low-rank
update. Object-identity grounding goes from 13.5% to 94.5%; full fine-tuning on the identical
demonstrations destroys it (12.5%). The cured policy obeys a renamed target on 200 of 200 trials and
grounds seven referent-type axes in one set of weights.

## Released artifacts

- Model (7-axis merged weight): https://huggingface.co/phi-monster/Galahad
- Model (object-family dual-output weight): https://huggingface.co/phi-monster/Galahad-object-unified
- Deconfounded datasets and their generator: https://huggingface.co/phi-monster
- Code, data generator, and the measurement battery: https://github.com/phi-monster/Galahad
- License: Apache 2.0 (code and models), CC BY 4.0 (paper)

## Terms defined here

- instruction blindness: a policy that completes an instructed task without reading the instruction
- swap-obey: rename the target, hold the scene fixed, and record whether the arm goes to the newly
  named object — a positive control rather than a drop under perturbation
- deconfounded data: demonstrations in which the instruction is the only variable predicting the target
